name: covas
description: Single-image annotation workspace for Codex — draw boxes, arrows, and freehand marks, then send annotated results back into the conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Single-image annotation workspace in the Codex sidebar.
interface.longDescription: Covas provides a focused, single-image annotation canvas in the Codex sidebar. Load a reference image, draw boxes, arrows, and freehand marks, and send the annotated result back into your conversation. State is persisted per session.
defaultPrompt: Show me the saved Covas annotation versions.
